feed.title: The Documented Record — revisions
feed.subtitle: Every dated change to the record, in the words of the record itself. Figures move because the bodies that count them publish again; findings are added as courts and commissions make them.
feed.rights: The record cites its sources; each source carries its own terms.

entry.title: Current edition.
entry.content: Current edition. The record runs in twenty-four Parts with Appendices A to F, from the pre-state period (1917-1948) to October 2026. It carries the Gaza casualty series to 8 October 2026 (74,254 killed, 175,306 injured; 72,835 identified by name); the legal record (the ICJ's orders and advisory opinions, the ICC's warrants, the UN Commission of Inquiry's two genocide findings, and the apartheid findings of B'Tselem, Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International); the documented statements of intent; Hamas's 7 October 2023 war crimes by the same evidentiary standard (Part XVIII, including the Hannibal Directive at §18.6); the West Bank, settlement and annexation record (Parts IX and X); the argument that Zionism is racism, its evidence and the replies to its critics (§21.12, Rebuttal 27); the Hebron court-martial of 1982-83 (§5.3A); the Holborn and St Pancras by-election and the Green leadership's response (§21.10); Benjamin Moser (§23.3); and the record of Israeli official disinformation (§19.7). The dashboard at palestinerecord.github.io is built from this document.
